written: 2026-10-21 ~19:00 JST, before any v12 episode; approved by the user ("可以")
kind: blind-only robustness tests of frozen controllers; no training
motivation: v7-v11 and the classical upper-bound arm show that on the undisturbed bench10 tasks every controller, the classical opponent included, lands at a mean ratio of ~1.0-1.1 and the 0.95 threshold is unreachable; the open-loop classical schedule is timer-based and cannot react during a manoeuvre, the learned layer sees the IMU. v12 tests both, frozen, in two scenarios neither was tuned for.

kick.change: one 20 ms torque hit of 3e-3 N m about a random horizontal axis (upset.install mechanism) at t0 + U(0.15, 0.45) s, i.e. during the manoeuvre

ood.condition: environment 'ood': lower bodies +12.5 % mass, stress disturbances on

scoring: bench10 (primary, unchanged); secondary variant settle_free: dash score minus its settle term (t_settle, or the 4 s miss constant that no controller avoids in the pitch/diag classes); evade/redirect unchanged

arms.cls_es: plan v11 classical upper-bound centres, seeds 1 (CloudPC-2, gen 15) and 2 (HomePC, gen 3)
arms.snn11: PRIMARY: plan v11 selected SNN+ES centres, seeds 1-5 (seed 2 = its selected imitation start; seeds 4-5 added when HomePC finishes, same cases)
arms.snn9: secondary: plan v9 selected centres, seeds 1-5

analysis: paired difference vs the classical opponent on identical cases with a paired bootstrap 95 % CI (paired_report), paired wins, crashes with exact 95 % intervals, crashes by type; pooled crash rate over both tests per arm

primary.name: H1
primary.per_test_per_seed: snn11 seed passes if the paired-delta 95 % CI lies below 0 AND its crashes <= the classical crashes on the same 192 cases
primary.holds_if: >= 3 of 5 snn11 seeds pass, evaluated separately for kick and for ood

stated_risk: the ES-tuned SNN runs with a heavier tilt tail (p99 ~55 deg vs 40 deg); a hit on top of that may crash it more often than the classical. Either outcome is reported.
machines: CloudPC-2 (kick, then ood); HomePC may take ood after its v11 chain; both bit-identical
not_allowed: changing kick magnitude/timing, scoring, bases or H1 after seeing results

kick_calibration.rule: magnitude fixed BEFORE any learned-arm episode as the largest calibrated level at which the frozen classical opponent crashes on <= 20 % of 24 calibration cases (8 per task, base 2_099_200_000, not a blind base)
kick_calibration.note: the first draft said 6e-3 (the hover calibration of upset.py); during a manoeuvre that level crashes the classical in 2/3 of cases, which would make the test a pure crash count
